title: Qvi d'amours n'a / Tant me plaist / Virga yesse (anonymous, Montpellier Codex)
desc: Anonymous, Qvi d'amours n'a / Tant me plaist / Virga yesse. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff. Transcribed from the original mensural notation at the original pitch; note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), a perfect value written with a dot. The tenor is a chant melody laid out in a repeated rhythm.
cr: From Measuring Polyphony (measuringpolyphony.org, ed. Karen Desmond). Licence: CC BY 3.0.

Tant me plaist . . a- mour ser- . . vir Que de riens . . ne . . mes- . . . ba- his de quant . . quil men . . cou- . vient souf- frir car li dous maus ma si es- pris que de ioi- e . . sui rem- plis tout dis quant me . . sou- . . uient de la dou- ce- te qui tant est bele et . sim- ple pu- . . ce- le a qui se- rai tous iours a- . . . mis
